label: Suggestion from the assistant - not an approved fact

panel.title: Assistant
panel.intro: The assistant answers from records you can read and from the playbook. It cannot approve, validate, change values or create evidence.
panel.noConversationsBody: Start a conversation to ask about the playbook or about records you can read.
panel.focusHint: Answers then use only records of this transformation, and charter or decision-brief suggestions can become drafts.
panel.noFocus: No focus: suggestions cannot become drafts.
panel.noMessages: No messages yet. Ask your first question.
panel.turnedOff: The assistant was turned off. Your earlier conversations can still be read. Every other feature works without it.
panel.full: This conversation has reached 100 messages. Start a new conversation.

refusal.assistant__refused__approval: The assistant cannot approve, reject or submit a business approval, a gate or any other approval. Open the record to decide yourself.
refusal.assistant__refused__benefit_validation: The assistant cannot validate or certify a benefit. Validation is done by an authorized person in the benefit record.
refusal.assistant__refused__value_change: The assistant cannot change values. It can explain a value or suggest what to check; any change is made by you in the record.
refusal.assistant__refused__evidence: The assistant cannot create, upload or invent evidence. Evidence is added by a person and linked to its record.

reply.refusalUnknown: The assistant refused this request. Nothing was changed.
reply.noSources: No record or playbook passage you can read matches this question. Nothing was sent to the model.
reply.unavailable: The assistant could not answer right now ({{code}}). Nothing was changed. Try again later.
reply.unavailableNoCode: The assistant could not answer right now. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
reply.interrupted: This question did not get an answer. Ask it again.
reply.withheld: This answer cites a record you can no longer read, so it is hidden.

citations.title: Sources
citations.notReadable: {{type}}, version {{version}} (you can no longer read it)
citations.noLink: No screen to open from here

suggestion.title: Suggestion {{ordinal}}
suggestion.adviceNote: Advice only: nothing is created from it.
suggestion.draftNote: Taking it to a draft creates a draft that you edit, save and submit yourself. Nothing is submitted or approved.
suggestion.draftCreated: Draft - not submitted. Open it to edit, save and submit it yourself.
suggestion.draftCreatedNoDraft: The suggestion was marked as taken, but the draft was not created. Open the record and create it yourself.
suggestion.withheld: This suggestion cites a record you can no longer read, so it is hidden.

admin.title: AI assistant
admin.subtitle: The optional assistant. It is off unless a technical administrator turns it on with a company authorization reference.
admin.telemetry: Telemetry and analytics: off. This installation contains no telemetry or analytics client.
admin.authorizationLimit: The reference is recorded as entered; the product does not check it with IT.
admin.lockedNote: While the assistant is on, the provider, endpoint, API style, model, credential and authorization reference cannot change. Turn it off first.
admin.readOnly: You can read this setting. Only a technical administrator can change it.
admin.noLiveClaim: No model endpoint is tested from this product. An HTTP endpoint is the one your IT provides; the product does not verify it.
admin.saved: Settings saved. The assistant stays off until it is turned on.
admin.enableBody: From now on, a user's question and the records that user can read may be sent to the configured endpoint. Give the reason.
admin.disableBody: From now on, no message is sent to a model. Conversations stay readable. Give the reason.

field.endpointHint: An http or https address without a user name, password, query or fragment. HTTPS is required in production.
field.credentialHint: A reference to a secret (provider and name), never the secret itself. Leave both empty for none.
field.authorizationHint: For example an IT approval ticket. 3 to 200 characters.

admin.rangeError: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
admin.credentialPairError: Enter both the provider and the name of the credential reference, or neither.
admin.lockedField: Locked while the assistant is on.
